title: Assign operating responsibilities explicitly
method: Synthetic eight-responsibility inventory: 2+3+3=8. Counts describe ownership allocation, not staffing or maturity. Separate toil example: 10×18 minutes=3 hours/month; 12/(3−1)=6-month simple effort payback.
alt: Assign operating responsibilities explicitly: Joint objectives 2 responsibilities, Application duties 3 responsibilities, Platform duties 3 responsibilities. Illustrative inputs.
